description: Discover observational relationships between model scale and benchmark capability in ObsScaling.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are agent capability  ABench-Code DB, agent capability  ABench-Code KG, agent capability  ABench-Code OS, agent capability  ABench-Game DCG, agent capability  ABench-Game HH, agent capability  ABench-Game LTP, and 252 more.
